verdict.rationale: Shortwave's docs say its AI learns your voice and style from the emails you send so it can write emails that sound like you (docs-51). Ghostwriter autocomplete is based on your previous emails so suggestions 'sound just like you' (docs-44). The AI assistant writes drafts (docs-12), and triggers can draft replies automatically when emails arrive for you to review (docs-1, docs-36). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that drafts actually match the user's voice, and detailed docs on how voice learning works (the key claim is a truncated marketing line).
